notes.title: Pizza Syntwhave is now free to play forever
notes.notes:
Dear players,
we are happy to announce that Pizza Synthwave is now absolutely free to play. This is the first ever game our studio released and it was a labor of love, hard work and determination. As we are working on our next projects, we want to thank everyone of you for the support. As a gift we decided to make the game free! Have fun, try speed runs and do your best to set records for each level! 

Warm regards,
Theseus Games

notes.title: We present to you the Pizza Synthwave NO-DEATH-RUN Challenge winner: KING TUPPER
notes.notes:

We are pleased to announce that a very talented player has completed a run of Pizza Synthwave without dying once and thus claimed the $ 250 reward!

You can check out the video of his amazing run here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EeIOxSZi3xs

notes.title: Announcing: GLOBAL LEADERBOARD is now live
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Pizza Synthwave Global Leaderboard is now live. You can now compete against players from all around the world to see who can set the best time for each level of the game. This update also adds the ability to instantly restart the level with F10.
Have fun competing!

notes.title: The $250$ No-Death-Run Challenge (CLOSED)
notes.notes:
Attention all  GAMERS! We would like to announce The Pizza Synthwave $250$ No-Death-Run Challenge.
The first person to complete a full run of the game without dying will get the prize money.
If you would like to participate please sign up here: https://forms.gle/LNuen6uh7WRPud7Q6

Rules: 
 1. To win the No Death Run Challenge Prize you have to complete all 30 levels of Pizza Synthwave without dying on single try.
2. Please upload the video to YouTube or Twitch and send us the link to theseusgamesstudios@gmail.com
3. The video must feature a recording of your complete gameplay and footage of you playing the game with your hands on your keyboard
4. The first person to complete the game without dying will get the prize
5. Do not cheat

notes.title: Pizza Synthwave now has amazing syntwhave music added
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42100335/8633f4fff7553f34e4df418d58975b79aae39bc7.png[/img]

After listening to hundreds of possible soundtrack candidates I've added music to the game. The tracks are beautiful and mesmerizing and fit perfectly to the overall atmosphere of the game. Also three more levels are completed and I'm working on adding a very interesting new gameplay mechanic.

Footage of that coming soon!
